description: OSM Land Polygons (Split version) - Large polygons are split; optimized for larger zoom levels and coastline rendering

acquisition.reason: provider.url is a landing page, and the artifact is a zip that must be extracted before ingestion. The setup script does not download or unzip; it errors out if land_polygons.shp is absent.
acquisition.note: Extract so that land_polygons.shp lands at region/global/raw/land-polygons-split-3857/. The .shx/.dbf/.prj/.cpg sidecars must sit beside it — ogr2ogr resolves them itself, and the script only ever names the .shp.
